## Let’s connect

software development, training, or reuse of HYDRA-EO resources, this page will direct
you to the right channel.

### Dr. Carlos Luis Camino González

**HYDRA-EO project lead · WU-DES**  
Laboratory of Geo-information Science and Remote Sensing  
Wageningen University & Research

Carlos coordinates the scientific programme and its integration of radiative transfer
modelling, plant traits, remote sensing, and machine learning. Contact him for project
collaboration, campaigns, consortium activities, and scientific dissemination.

::: {.contact-actions}

:::

### Software & technical support

For bugs, feature requests, or reproducible technical questions, open an issue in the
repository of the relevant tool so the discussion remains visible and reusable.

[Open RTM-Suite on GitHub ↗](https://github.com/CCGCAM/RTM-Suite){.contact-text-link}
